{{Top|leg}}
The '''Corellian Cheek-Step''' was a type of dance<ref name="SWKotOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref> developed by [[3956 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'' to [[3956 BBY]].</ref> It involved the wriggling of one's posterior in the air and partially shared its name<ref name="SWKotOR" /> with the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> In 3956 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]],<ref name="NEC" /> the dance was known to the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] dancer [[Lyn Sekla]], who was stuck on<ref name="SWKotOR" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]<ref name="Taris">{{LucasArts|url=products/swkotor/W_taris.html|text=Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic - Taris}}</ref> planet [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] due to its occupation by [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire]].<ref name="SWKotOR" /> 

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|How hard can it be?''"<br />"''You think this is easy? I've trained for years to develop my talents. Dancing isn't just wiggling your butt in the air, you know! Well, except for the Corellian Cheek-Step.|Revan fails to convince Lyn Sekla to allow him to help her|<ref name="SWKotOR" />}}
The Corellian Cheek-Step was introduced in the [[2003]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''. The dance is mentioned solely by the character Lyn Sekla should the player character, the amnesiac former [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]], fail a persuade dialogue option at [[Javyar's Cantina]] on Taris.<ref name="SWKotOR" />
